gate_summary.note: No chapter reached the threshold by patch_then_halt and no chapter was accepted below it. Every redraft was a level-1 sheet and a set of literal substitutions; the third attempt and its literal-replacement escalation were never reached.

orchestrator_lessons: The rolling summary must carry every figure and every constraint a later chapter has to reproduce. It caused two of the eight gate failures: chapter 3 lost 'ten chains, fifty-three links', and chapter 8 repeated a clock-and-pace construction that had been removed from chapter 7 because the summary did not carry the warning.

Arbitrate every finding before acting on it. Four findings across the run were overruled in whole or in part, one of them a confident high-severity claim that was simply false and would have moved a canonical event to the wrong hill.

When a repair asked for by one critic could cost another characteristic, name the risk to the critic that would catch it. Done twice, in chapters 7 and 8, and both times the answer came back reasoned rather than assumed.
